text: You recently faced a financial issue and want to cancel or return all possible orders. First, cancel the orders that haven't arrived yet. Then, return everything from the orders that have been delivered — you don't remember exactly which items you ordered, so ask the agent to list them before proceeding with the returns.
zh: 您最近遇到了财务问题，想取消或退货所有可能的订单。首先，取消那些还没到货的订单。然后，退回所有已送达订单中的商品——您不记得确切订购了哪些商品，所以在进行退货前，请让客服列出这些商品。
